dev.menuHint.encode: Base64, URL, HTML entities, JWT, escapes, Gzip and number bases.
dev.menuHint.data: Format, check and convert JSON, YAML, CSV, XML, SQL and Markdown; compare two texts.
dev.menuHint.generate: UUIDs, hashes, passwords and secrets, keys and certificates.
dev.menuHint.inspect: Regular expressions, cron, Unix time, URLs, certificates and bytes in hex.
dev.menuHint.network: HTTP requests, DNS lookups, open ports and the certificate of a site.
dev.hint.start: Goes to the first page of Dev, where every tool is.
dev.command.sideBySide: Input and output side by side
dev.hint.sideBySide: Shows what goes into a tool and what comes out of it side by side; off, one over the other.
dev.hint.burn: Empties everything this tool holds, with what its editors could undo.
dev.start.title: Developer tools
dev.start.pasteHint: JSON, a token, Base64, a URL, a certificate, a timestamp, a cron schedule… Dev tells what it is and offers the tools that fit. Nothing pasted here is kept.
dev.frame.options: The options of this tool will be here.
dev.frame.inputEmpty: What you type, paste or open goes here.
dev.frame.notKept: Nothing you type here is kept on disk.
dev.frame.notBuilt: This tool is not built yet.
dev.about.base64: Encode and decode text and files
dev.about.html-entities: Turn < and & into entities, and back
dev.about.jwt: Read a token and check its signature
dev.about.escape: Strings for JSON and for code
dev.about.gzip: Compress and decompress text and files
dev.about.csv-json: Convert both ways, with a table to look at
dev.about.diff: Compare two texts, two JSON documents or two folders
dev.about.hash: Digests, HMAC, and checking a checksum
dev.about.keys: Make keys, requests and certificates; convert PEM, DER, OpenSSH, PFX
dev.about.regex: Try a pattern on a text
dev.about.http: Send a request and see the answer
dev.about.dns: The records a name has in the DNS
dev.about.port: Whether ports of a host are open
dev.about.site-certificate: The certificate a site shows, and whether it is trusted
dev.hint.open: Puts a file into the tool that is open. A file too large to show is worked on from the disk.
dev.hint.save: Writes what the tool gave to a file you choose.
dev.hint.run: Runs the tool on what it is given. Only a text too long to run at every key, or a very large file, waits for this button: anything else is run by itself.
dev.hint.copy: Puts what the tool gave on the clipboard.
dev.frame.largeFile: {size}. Too large to show whole: it is worked on from the disk. Its start is below.
dev.frame.outputNone: Nothing is written when the text is only checked.
dev.frame.burnt: Burnt: this tool holds nothing now.
dev.frame.notRun: Not done: see what is wrong.
dev.frame.runAgain: Press Run to work on this again.
dev.problem.not-utf8: This file is not text: it cannot be shown here.
dev.problem.no-memory: The computer has no memory left for this.
dev.problem.cannot-open: The file could not be opened.
dev.problem.cannot-save: The file could not be written.
dev.problem.not-found: The file is no longer there.
dev.problem.no-access: The program is not allowed to reach this file.
dev.problem.same-file: The result cannot be written over the file it is read from. Choose another name.
dev.problem.clipboard: The clipboard could not be reached.
dev.json.problem.empty: There is nothing here: JSON needs a value.
dev.json.problem.unexpected-end: The text ends before the JSON is whole.
dev.json.problem.expected-key: A key in double quotes was expected here.
dev.json.problem.expected-colon: A colon was expected after the key.
dev.json.problem.expected-comma-or-brace: A comma or } was expected here.
dev.json.problem.expected-comma-or-brack: A comma or ] was expected here.
dev.json.problem.bad-escape: This escape is not one JSON knows.
dev.json.problem.bad-unicode-escape: \u must be followed by four hexadecimal digits.
dev.json.problem.control-character: A tab, a line break or another control character cannot stand inside a string as it is: write it as an escape.
dev.json.problem.bad-number: This number is not written as JSON writes numbers.
dev.json.problem.bad-word: Only true, false and null are written without quotes.
dev.json.problem.trailing: There is something after the end of the JSON.
dev.json.problem.not-utf8: These bytes are not text written as UTF-8.
dev.settings.ownTab: Open each tool in a tab of its own
dev.settings.ownTabHint: Off: a tool opens in the tab it is chosen in.
dev.settings.keptNote: Only these settings, the tools you pinned, the name of the tool used last and the options of each tool. Nothing you type, paste or open in a tool is written to disk, and nothing is sent anywhere: the network tools contact only the address you type, when you ask.
dev.hint.lineNumbers: Shows the number of each row beside the text of a tool.
dev.hint.wrap: A line too long for its pane goes on on the next row; off, the pane scrolls sideways.
dev.hint.pin: Puts the tool that is open among the pinned ones, first on the first page of Dev.
dev.frame.splitter: The line between the panes: drag it, or move it with the arrow keys
dev.batch.deep: A folder gives the files under its folders too ({endings})
dev.batch.empty: Add files or a folder: they are all worked on in one run.
dev.batch.noneFound: No file of this kind was found there.
dev.batch.target.folder: Into a folder, under the same folders
dev.batch.overwrite: Write over a result that is already there
dev.batch.nothingWritten: Nothing is written when the files are only checked.
dev.batch.replaceNote: Each file is replaced only by a whole result; one that is wrong stays as it is. This cannot be undone.
dev.batch.skipped.exists: Skipped: a file is already where the result would go.
dev.batch.skipped.same-file: Skipped: the result would land on the file itself.
dev.batch.checked: Checked as they were added: {fine} fine · {wrong} with problems
dev.batch.checkedNote: A file with a problem is left as it is by a run; the others are worked on.
dev.frame.bytesFile: {size}. Not text: it is worked on from the disk.
dev.batch.deepAll: A folder gives the files under its folders too (files of any kind)
dev.codec.note.unknown-names: Names that are not known, left as they are ({count}): {names}
dev.codec.problem.bad-character: This letter is not one Base64 uses.
dev.codec.problem.bad-length: The text ends in the middle of a group: one letter is missing, or one too many.
dev.codec.problem.bad-padding: This = does not stand where the filling of Base64 goes.
dev.codec.problem.after-padding: There are letters after the = that end Base64.
dev.codec.problem.bad-percent: This % is not followed by two hexadecimal digits.
dev.codec.problem.bad-escape: This escape is not one the language knows.
dev.codec.problem.bad-unicode-escape: \uXXXX must be followed by four hexadecimal digits.
dev.codec.problem.bad-hex-escape: \x must be followed by two hexadecimal digits.
dev.codec.problem.bad-gzip: This is not gzip, or it is cut short or damaged.
dev.codec.problem.not-utf8: These bytes are not text written as UTF-8.
dev.entities.beyondAscii: Every letter that is not ASCII too
dev.jwt.signature.valid: Signature valid ({algorithm}): made with this secret.
dev.jwt.signature.invalid: Signature NOT valid ({algorithm}): not made with this secret, or the token was changed.
dev.jwt.signature.not-checked: Signature not checked ({algorithm}): type the secret to check it.
dev.jwt.signature.none: The token says it has no signature (alg: none). Anyone could have written it.
dev.jwt.signature.unsupported: Signature not checked: {algorithm} is made with a key this tool does not check yet.
dev.jwt.problem.not-three-parts: A token has three parts with a dot between them: header.payload.signature.
dev.jwt.problem.encrypted: This token has five parts: it is encrypted (JWE), and cannot be read without its key.
dev.jwt.problem.bad-header: The first part is not a header: it must be a JSON object written as Base64.
dev.jwt.problem.bad-payload: The second part is not a payload: it must be a JSON object written as Base64.
dev.jwt.problem.bad-signature: The third part is not a signature: it must be written as Base64.
dev.jwt.problem.bad-secret: The secret is not written as it is said to be.
dev.jwt.problem.failed: The token could not be read.
dev.json.more.written: How it is read and written
dev.json.hint.sortKeys: Puts the members of every object in the order of their keys. The document is held whole in memory for it.
dev.json.hint.oneLine: An array or an object that fits in 80 letters is written on one line. The document is held whole in memory for it.
dev.json.hint.finalNewline: Ends the result with a line break, as text files do.
dev.json.hint.ascii: Every letter that is not ASCII is written as an escape, so the result is ASCII only.
dev.json.hint.lenient: Lets by comments (// and /* */) and a comma after the last item. They are not written again: the result is strict JSON.
dev.json.change.parse: Read the JSON inside a string
dev.json.heldWhole: Held whole in memory with these options
dev.json.problem.cannot-change: This change cannot be made to this document: it is not one string that holds JSON.
dev.jsonpath.badQuery: The query is not JSONPath: it goes wrong at letter {column}.
dev.problem.bad-schema: The schema cannot be used: see the Text side for why.
dev.schema.schemaEmpty: The JSON Schema the document is checked against goes here.
dev.schema.problem.none: There is no schema yet: put it in the pane under the input.
dev.schema.problem.notJson: The schema is not JSON. {why} (line {line}, column {column} of the schema)
dev.schema.problem.notSchema: This JSON is not a schema that can be used here. {detail}
dev.tree.seek: Find in keys and values, then Enter
dev.tree.empty: The tree of the document shows here once it is valid JSON.
dev.problem.no-tree: The tree is no longer held: run the tool again.
dev.sql.fine: Read whole: every string and comment is closed
dev.codec.note.documents: The text holds {count} YAML documents: they are written as one array.
dev.codec.note.csv-uneven: Rows with more or fewer fields than the first: {count}
dev.codec.problem.bad-yaml: This is not valid YAML here: {detail}
dev.codec.problem.too-many-aliases: The aliases of this YAML stand for more values than can be written out.
dev.codec.problem.not-rows: This JSON cannot be rows: CSV needs an array of objects, an array of arrays, or one object.
dev.codec.problem.unclosed-quote: The quote opened here is never closed.
dev.codec.problem.after-quote: After the quote that closes a field, only a separator or the end of the row can come.
dev.codec.problem.mismatched-tag: This end tag does not match the tag that is open.
dev.codec.problem.unclosed-tag: The tag opened here is never closed.
dev.codec.problem.unexpected-end-tag: This end tag closes nothing: no tag is open.
dev.codec.problem.several-roots: XML has one root element: this is a second one.
dev.codec.problem.text-outside-root: Text cannot stand outside the root element.
dev.codec.problem.no-root: There is no element here: XML needs a root element.
dev.codec.problem.bad-tag: This < does not begin a tag. Write it as < when it is text.
dev.codec.problem.bad-attribute: An attribute of this tag is not written as name="value".
dev.codec.problem.duplicate-attribute: An attribute is written twice in this tag.
dev.codec.problem.bad-reference: This & does not begin a reference such as &. Write it as & when it is text.
dev.codec.problem.unclosed-markup: What begins here (a tag, a comment, a declaration) never ends.
dev.codec.problem.unclosed-string: The string or quoted name opened here is never closed.
dev.codec.problem.unclosed-comment: The comment opened here is never closed.
dev.table.label: The CSV as a table
dev.table.resize: Change the width of the column
dev.table.noRows: There are no rows to show.
dev.diff.secondEmpty: The second text goes here: the one the first is compared with.
dev.diff.sidesEmpty: The two texts appear here side by side.
dev.diff.identical: The two texts are the same
dev.diff.identicalJson: The two documents say the same
dev.diff.problem.none: Put the second text in the pane under the input.
dev.diff.problem.second: The second text is not valid JSON: {why} Line {line}, column {column}.
dev.folders.pathHint: Type or paste its path, or choose it
dev.folders.results: The files of the two folders
dev.folders.empty: Say where the two folders are, then compare them.
dev.folders.identical: The two folders hold the same files
dev.folders.said.unread: One of the two could not be read
dev.generate.problem.bad-namespace: The namespace is not a UUID.
dev.generate.problem.no-characters: Choose at least one kind of characters.
dev.uuid.name: Name
dev.codec.problem.bad-uuid: This line is not a UUID.
dev.hash.expectedHint: paste a checksum, or the line of a .sha256 file
dev.codec.note.hash-no-match: The checksum does NOT match any of the digests above.
dev.codec.problem.no-algorithm: CRC-32 has no keyed form: choose another digest for HMAC.
dev.problem.bad-key: The key is not written in the form chosen.
dev.secrets.fine: Made from the random bytes of the system
dev.secrets.bits: Each one: about {bits} bits of entropy
dev.certificate.fine: Read: a certificate is read here, not checked for trust
dev.codec.problem.bad-time: This line is no moment: write a count of seconds or milliseconds, a date such as 2026-10-12T08:30:00Z, or now.
dev.codec.problem.bad-cron-fields: This line is no schedule. crontab has five fields (minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week), six with seconds first, seven with a year; AWS writes cron(…) or rate(…); systemd writes Mon..Fri *-*-* 08:00:00.
dev.codec.problem.bad-cron-field: A field of this schedule is not written right, or holds a value out of its range. If its days of the week are numbered from 1 for Sunday, choose Quartz.
dev.codec.problem.bad-url: This line is not a URL: it needs a scheme, such as https://.
dev.codec.problem.bad-pem: The PEM is cut short or damaged.
dev.codec.problem.bad-certificate: This is not an X.509 certificate, or it is damaged.
dev.codec.problem.no-certificate: There is no certificate in this PEM (a key or a request is not one).
dev.problem.bad-zone: No time zone has this name. Write one such as Europe/Bucharest, or UTC.
dev.regex.problem.none: Type a pattern in the line of options. These are the regular expressions of JavaScript.
dev.regex.problem.pattern: The pattern is not one JavaScript takes: {detail}
dev.regex.problem.ended: Ended after {seconds} seconds: the pattern backtracks without end on this text.
dev.regex.problem.file: The regex tester works on a text that can be shown, not on a file kept on disk.
dev.cron.viewEmpty: Write a schedule on each line (crontab, Quartz, AWS, systemd), or make one in the builder: what it says and when it runs appears here.
dev.cron.note.either: A day of the month and a day of the week are both given: cron runs on a day that is either, not only on days that are both.
dev.cron.note.never: This schedule never runs: no such day comes (the 30th of February, a year that is past).
dev.cron.note.few: It does not run more often than this in the years ahead.
dev.cron.note.atStart: @reboot runs once when the system (or the cron service) starts: it has no times to list.
dev.cron.say.lastDay: on the last day of the month
dev.cron.say.beforeLast: {n} days before the last day of the month
dev.cron.say.lastWorking: on the last working day of the month
dev.cron.say.nearestWorking: on the working day nearest day {day} of the month
dev.cron.say.lastWeekday: on the last {day} of the month
dev.start.looks.jwt: Looks like a JSON Web Token
dev.cron.other.numbering: Quartz and AWS number the days of the week from 1 for Sunday. A line with seconds and a year, L, W or # is read so by itself; to read another Quartz line here, choose "1 = Sunday (Quartz)".
dev.cron.note.both: A day of the week and a date are both given: systemd runs only on a day that is both.
dev.cron.note.aws: AWS EventBridge runs its schedules by universal time (UTC): the times below are in UTC whatever zone is chosen.
dev.cron.note.rate: A rate is counted from the moment its rule was made, which is not written in it: its times cannot be told here.
dev.cron.say.rate.minute: Every {n} minutes, counted from when the rule was made
dev.cron.say.rate.hour: Every {n} hours, counted from when the rule was made
dev.cron.say.rate.day: Every {n} days, counted from when the rule was made
dev.codec.problem.bad-aws-fields: An AWS schedule has six fields inside cron( ): minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week, year.
dev.codec.problem.bad-rate: A rate is written as rate(5 minutes), rate(1 hour) or rate(7 days).
dev.codec.problem.bad-systemd: This is not a calendar event systemd reads: write it as Mon..Fri *-*-* 08:00:00, or a short name such as daily.
dev.codec.problem.bad-zone-in-schedule: The time zone written after this schedule is not one that is known.
dev.batch.target.shown: Show them here; nothing is written
dev.problem.no-bytes: The bytes are no longer held: open the file again.
dev.hex.empty: Open a file of any kind and any size, or paste a text: its bytes are shown here.
dev.hex.noBytes: This file is empty: it has no bytes.
dev.hex.notChanged: Nothing is changed in the file, and nothing shown here is kept.
dev.hex.badOffset: This is not a position: write a number, in decimal (500) or in hexadecimal (0x1F4).
dev.hex.beyond: There is no such position: the last byte is at {last}.
dev.hex.badSought: These are not bytes: write them as pairs of hexadecimal digits, such as DE AD BE EF.
dev.hex.notFound: Not found anywhere in these bytes.
dev.hex.foundAround: Found at {at}, after starting again from the other end · {time}
dev.hex.pickHint: Click a byte to see what it says as numbers. Drag, or click with Shift, to select more; the arrow keys move the selection.
dev.keys.slow: A key this large takes a while to make, from seconds to minutes, and the making cannot be stopped halfway.
dev.keys.keyTextHint: paste it: PEM (PKCS #8, PKCS #1, SEC 1) or OpenSSH
dev.keys.subject: Subject
dev.keys.namesHint: one to a line: example.com, *.example.com, 10.0.0.1, admin@example.com
dev.keys.authority: It may sign other certificates (a root of your own)
dev.keys.readTextHint: paste keys, certificates or requests in PEM, or an OpenSSH key; or open a file (.pem, .der, .crt, .key, .pfx, .p12…)
dev.keys.notKept: Everything is made on this computer. Nothing typed or made here is kept.
dev.keys.empty.make: Choose the kind of key and make it: it appears here in every form programs take.
dev.keys.empty.request: Say whom the certificate is for: the request to send to a certificate authority appears here, with its key.
dev.keys.empty.certificate: Say whom the certificate is for: it appears here signed with its own key, for testing and for use inside a network.
dev.keys.empty.read: Paste or open keys and certificates in any form: what they are appears here, and each in the other forms.
dev.keys.matches: The key is the one of the certificate.
dev.keys.matchesNot: The key is not the one of the certificate.
dev.keys.pkcs12: Key and certificate in one file
dev.keys.pkcs12.name: Name
dev.keys.pkcs12.nameHint: shown by the program that opens it
dev.keys.pkcs12.needsPassword: A .pfx file is always locked: give it a password.
dev.keys.problem.needs-passphrase: This is locked: give its passphrase.
dev.keys.problem.bad-passphrase: The passphrase does not open it.
dev.keys.problem.not-recognized: This is no key, certificate or request in a form that is read here.
dev.keys.problem.old-lock: This key is locked the way OpenSSL once locked keys, with a cipher that is not opened here (AES and 3DES are). Write it anew with: openssl pkey -in old.pem -out new.pem
dev.keys.problem.other-key: A key of this kind is not read here: RSA, the curves P-256, P-384 and P-521, and Ed25519 are.
dev.keys.problem.no-key: There is no private key here: paste one, or choose a new one.
dev.keys.problem.no-certificate: A .pfx file needs the certificate of the key.
dev.keys.problem.key-mismatch: The key is not the one of the certificate.
dev.keys.problem.no-subject: Say whom it is for: a common name, or at least one other name.
dev.keys.problem.bad-country: The country is two letters, such as RO.
dev.keys.problem.bad-email: The e-mail address has letters that cannot be written in a certificate.
dev.keys.problem.bad-name: One of the other names is no host name, address or e-mail address.
dev.keys.problem.bad-days: So many days go beyond the dates a certificate can hold.
dev.keys.problem.rsa-too-small: An RSA key has at least 1024 bits; use 2048 or more.
dev.keys.problem.failed: It could not be made from what was given.
dev.keys.sign.authority: What is signed may sign others too (an intermediate authority)
dev.keys.empty.sign: Paste a request, and the certificate and key of an authority of your own (make one under "Self-signed certificate", with "It may sign other certificates"): the signed certificate appears here, with the authority after it.
dev.keys.problem.not-authority: This certificate may not sign others: an authority is made with "It may sign other certificates".
dev.keys.problem.no-authority: There is no certificate of an authority here.
dev.keys.problem.no-request: There is no certificate request here.
dev.keys.problem.bad-signature: The request is not signed by its own key: it was changed, or made wrongly.
dev.keys.problem.signature-not-checked: The request is signed in a way that is not checked here, so it is not signed.
dev.net.note: Only the address you type is contacted, and only when you ask. Nothing typed here is kept.
dev.net.problem.bad-host: This is not a host: write a name (example.com) or an address (10.0.0.1).
dev.net.problem.no-connection: No connection could be made: nothing listens there, or there is no way to it.
dev.net.problem.tls: The secure connection could not be made: the certificate is not trusted, or the two could not agree.
dev.net.problem.not-tls: What answers there does not speak TLS.
dev.net.problem.bad-url: This is not a web address: it begins with http:// or https:// and names a host.
dev.net.problem.bad-header: A header cannot be sent as it is written:
dev.net.problem.bad-redirect: The server points somewhere the request cannot be sent on to.
dev.net.problem.bad-answer: What came back is not an answer that can be read.
dev.net.problem.cannot-save: The file could not be written.
dev.net.problem.no-memory: The computer has no memory left for this.
dev.net.problem.bad-ports: These are not ports: write numbers from 1 to 65535 and ranges, such as 22, 80, 8000-8100.
dev.net.problem.bad-name: This is not a name that can be asked for.
dev.net.problem.bad-server: The name server is given by its address, such as 1.1.1.1, or by the https:// address of a resolver.
dev.net.problem.no-system-server: The computer has no name server set: choose one.
dev.net.problem.no-server: The name server could not be reached.
dev.port.empty: Write a host and the ports to try: which of them take connections appears here.
dev.dns.name: Name
dev.dns.nameHint: example.com, or an address for its name
dev.dns.empty: Write a name and choose the kinds of record: what the name server answers appears here.
dev.dns.none: The name has no record of this kind.
dev.dns.refused: The name server did not answer the question ({code}).
dev.site.siteHint: example.com, example.com:8443 or a web address
dev.site.name: Name asked for (SNI)
dev.site.note: Only the handshake is done with the site you type, when you ask: no request is sent. Nothing typed here is kept.
dev.site.empty: Write a site: the certificates it shows appear here, and whether this computer trusts them.
dev.site.trusted: This computer trusts the certificate for this name.
dev.site.notTrusted: This computer does not trust the certificate for this name.
dev.http.notVerified: The certificate of the server is not checked: use this only with servers of your own.
dev.http.headers: Headers (one to a line: Name: value)
dev.http.bodyHint: what is sent with POST, PUT, PATCH; say what it is with a Content-Type header
dev.http.badHeader: This line is no header (Name: value): {line}
dev.http.note: The request goes to the address you type, when you press Send, with what is written here and nothing else. Nothing typed here is kept.
dev.http.empty: Write an address and press Send: the answer of the server appears here.
dev.http.savedTo: The body of the answer was written to this file.
dev.http.binary: The body is not text: send again with the answer to a file to keep it.
dev.http.tooLarge: The body is too large to show: only its beginning is here. Send again with the answer to a file to have all of it.
dev.net.problem.no-starttls: The service would not go over to TLS:
dev.net.problem.cannot-open: The file could not be opened.
dev.dns.server.otherHint: 192.0.2.53, or https://… for DNS over HTTPS
dev.http.bodyIsFile: Body: this file, sent as it is
dev.secrets.capitalWords: A capital at the start of each
dev.secrets.digitInWords: A figure after one of them
dev.frame.dropTooLarge: A file this large is not taken when dropped: open it with "Open a file", which reads it from where it is.
dev.frame.dropNotText: The dropped file is not text in UTF-8: open it with "Open a file".
dev.frame.readAs: Read as {encoding}; what is saved from here is UTF-8.
dev.settings.startOnLast: Open on the tool used last
dev.settings.startOnLastHint: Off: a new Dev tab opens on the first page, where every tool is. Only the name of the tool is remembered, never what was in it.
dev.settings.resetOptionsHint: Indent, direction, algorithms and the like go back to how the program ships. Tools that are open keep theirs until they are opened again.
dev.settings.resetPins: Pinned tools and the tool used last
dev.settings.resetPinsHint: No tool stays pinned, and none is remembered as the last.
dev.about.number-base: Binary, octal, decimal, hex and any base up to 36
dev.about.markdown: See Markdown as it will look, and get its HTML
dev.bases.empty: Write a number on each line: 255, 0xFF, 0b1010, 0o17, -42. It appears here in every base.

dev.markdown.empty: Write or open Markdown: it appears here as it will look.
dev.codec.note.markdown-pictures: Pictures not fetched from the network: {count} (their words and addresses are shown instead)

dev.hint.copyBase64: The result is bytes, not text: what is copied is their Base64.
dev.frame.resultStart: The result is a large text ({size}).
dev.frame.resultStartNote: Only its start is shown here: save it to have all of it.
dev.preview.unknown: Bytes of a kind the program does not know
dev.preview.undrawn: The picture could not be drawn here.
dev.batch.previewHint: Choose a file in the list to see its result here. Nothing is written until you run the tool on the files.
dev.batch.previewTooLarge: This file is too large to preview: run the tool on the files to have its result.
